title: Dual Shapiro steps and fundamental transconductance in the dc-driven Bloch transistor
summary: We propose a superconducting circuit based on the Bloch transistor, a quantum device consisting of two small-capacitance Josephson junctions, connected in series and having a small superconducting island in between. This device is driven by two dc electrical sources controlling Josephson oscillations of frequency $f_J = 2e\overline{V_J}/h$, related to the average transistor voltage $\overline{V_J}$, and Bloch oscillations of frequency $f_B = \overline{I_B}/2e$, related to the average current $\overline{I_B}$ injected into the transistor island.
